{
  "jobspec": "#!/bin/sh

# Flux batch script (translated from PBS)

# PBS requested:
#   -l select=2:system=polaris
#   -l place=scatter
#   -l walltime=8:00:00
#   -l filesystems=home:eagle
#   -q preemptable
#   -A datascience
#   -N GNN_DDP_4

flux alloc \
  -N 2 \
  --time=8h \
  --queue=preemptable \
  bash -lc '

# NOTE: PBS -A datascience (account/project) has no universally portable Flux batch directive.
# Performance implication: none for runtime, but accounting/charging/allocation association may be incorrect.

# NOTE: PBS system=polaris has no universally portable Flux directive.
# Performance implication: job may run on a different system/partition if this Flux instance spans multiple systems,
# potentially impacting performance or compatibility.

# NOTE: PBS place=scatter has no universally portable Flux directive in a batch script.
# Performance implication: placement may differ (e.g., closer/farther nodes), affecting communication performance.

# NOTE: PBS filesystems=home:eagle has no universally portable Flux directive.
# Performance implication: required filesystem access/policies may not be enforced, possibly causing I/O issues or failures.

# NOTE: PBS job name (-N GNN_DDP_4) has no universally portable Flux batch directive.
# Performance implication: none (metadata only), but job identification in monitoring/accounting may be less clear.

cd "${PBS_O_WORKDIR:-$PWD}"

TSTAMP=$(date "+%Y-%m-%d-%H%M%S")
echo "Job started at: {$TSTAMP}"

# Load modules:
source /lus/eagle/projects/datascience/sbarwey/codes/ml/pytorch_geometric/module_config

# Determine node/GPU counts.
# NOTE: PBS_NODEFILE may not exist under Flux; fall back to Flux allocation size if available.
if [ -n "${PBS_NODEFILE:-}" ] && [ -f "${PBS_NODEFILE}" ]; then
  NUM_NODES=$(wc -l < "${PBS_NODEFILE}")
  HOSTFILE_OPT="--hostfile=\"${PBS_NODEFILE}\""
else
  NUM_NODES=${FLUX_RESOURCE_NNODES:-2}
  HOSTFILE_OPT=""
fi

NGPUS_PER_NODE=$(nvidia-smi -L | wc -l)
NGPUS="$((NUM_NODES*NGPUS_PER_NODE))"

echo $NUM_NODES $NGPUS_PER_NODE $NGPUS

# NOTE: This command relies on mpiexec options specific to the site integration (e.g., --ppn, --hostfile).
# Flux MPI integration is site-specific; there is no universally portable translation.
# Performance implication: ranks may not map correctly to nodes/GPUs or the launch may fail unless mpiexec is
# configured to work inside a Flux allocation on your system.

mpiexec \
	--verbose \
	--envall \
	-n $NGPUS \
	--ppn $NGPUS_PER_NODE \
	${HOSTFILE_OPT} \
    --cpu-bind none \
	./set_affinity_gpu_polaris.sh python3 main.py seed=65 use_noise=True topk_rf=4
'
"
}
